rice.name: Rice / Paddy
rice.description: Cereal staple crop susceptible to stem borers (deadhearts/whiteheads), plant hoppers, and leaf folders.

chemical.product_name: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC or Cartap Hydrochloride 50% SP
chemical.timing: Apply at peak egg-hatching before larvae penetrate the leaf sheath

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Release 50,000 parasitoids/ha; spray Bt at 2 g/L during early instars
organic_biocontrol.timing: Release at first moth emergence

recommendations.safety_precautions: Maintain 5 cm water level during application. Wear protective neoprene gloves, mask, and goggles.

chemical.timing: Target early tillering (deadheart prevention) or booting stage (whitehead prevention)

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Install 20 sex pheromone lures per hectare at canopy level
organic_biocontrol.timing: Deploy from seedling transplanting through heading

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not apply near fish or shrimp sanctuaries. Wear respirator and protective boots.

chemical.timing: Direct nozzle spray at the base of the rice hills where hoppers congregate

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 5 g/L fungal spore formulation with mild vegetable surfactant
organic_biocontrol.timing: Spray in late afternoon to maintain high humidity

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid excessive synthetic pyrethroids which cause BPH resurgence. Wear standard PPE.

chemical.timing: Spray when longitudinal folded leaves first appear on flag leaves

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt subsp. kurstaki) + Neem Extract
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 2.5 g/L Bt + 3 ml/L cold-pressed Neem oil
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply early evening

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear mask and goggles. Avoid inhaling spray droplets.

chemical.timing: Apply as seedling root dip or foliar spray at tillering

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Refrain from broad-spectrum insecticides to conserve natural wasps
organic_biocontrol.timing: Throughout vegetative period

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear waterproof gloves and face shield.

chemical.timing: Foliar spray when nymphs or adults exceed economic threshold

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 50 ml extract per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Weekly preventative application

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid spraying during windy conditions. Wash exposed skin.

corn.name: Corn / Maize
corn.description: Cereal crop vulnerable to Fall Armyworm, Corn Borers, and ear feeding pests.

chemical.product_name: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG
chemical.dosage: 0.4 ml/L Chlorantraniliprole OR 0.4 g/L Emamectin Benzoate
chemical.timing: Target the corn whorl funnel directly during early vegetative growth

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Spodoptera frugiperda Multiple Nucleopolyhedrovirus (SfMNPV) or Bt
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 1-2 ml/L bio-virus or 2 g/L Bt kurstaki applied inside leaf whorls
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply late afternoon into the funnel

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear full PPE including chemical respirator and rubber gloves. Never spray upwind.

chemical.timing: Apply at tasseling before larvae bore into stalks

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Release 50-70 Trichocards per hectare at 7-day intervals
organic_biocontrol.timing: Release at first moth flight detection

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not apply within 50 meters of freshwater streams or apiaries.

chemical.timing: Spray foliage when young larvae feed gregariously on leaf blades

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 2 g per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply early morning or late afternoon

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear face shield and protective apron.

chemical.timing: Foliar spray when upper leaves and tassels are encrusted with honeydew

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 5 ml per Liter of water with mild dish soap emulsifier
organic_biocontrol.timing: Spot spray clusters

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear certified respirator and chemical gloves.

chemical.dosage: 2.0 ml per Liter of water directed around seedling collar
chemical.timing: Evening application around base of severed seedlings

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Wheat Bran + Molasses + Bt Cutworm Bait
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Scatter poisoned bait pellets around seedling bases at dusk
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply at dusk when cutworms emerge to feed

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not contaminate livestock grazing areas. Wear heavy rubber gloves.

mungbean.name: Mungbean
mungbean.description: Legume crop sensitive to pod borers, aphids, thrips, and blister beetles.

chemical.timing: Early morning spray at first cluster appearance

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 3-5 ml per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Spray late afternoon on undersides of leaves

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear rubber gloves and face mask. Toxic to bees; do NOT spray during bloom.

chemical.timing: Early morning spray on tender shoots

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 4 ml per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Late afternoon spray

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear protective gloves and eye protection.

chemical.timing: Spot spray foliage where adult swarms congregate

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Hand-picking with Gloves & Soapy Water Drop
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Do NOT crush by hand (cantharidin toxin causes severe skin blisters)
organic_biocontrol.timing: Collect early morning when beetles are lethargic

recommendations.safety_precautions: CAUTION: Cantharidin blister agent. Never handle live or dead beetles with bare skin.

chemical.timing: Direct fine mist spray into opened flowers and tender shoot tips

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Place 10 blue traps/ha; spray 4 g/L fungal suspension
organic_biocontrol.timing: Continuous monitoring

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear particulate respirator and goggles.

chemical.timing: Spray at flower bud initiation before larvae enter pods

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 2 g per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply when young caterpillars emerge

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear protective coveralls and goggles.

squash.name: Squash / Cucurbits
squash.description: Vining vegetable vulnerable to squash bugs, fruit flies, and whiteflies.

chemical.product_name: Malathion 57% EC with Protein Hydrolysate Bait
chemical.dosage: 1.5 ml Malathion + 10 g Protein Bait per Liter of water
chemical.timing: Spot spray foliage (not fruit directly) as attractant bait

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Methyl Eugenol Pheromone Traps & Fruit Bagging
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Deploy 1 trap per 100 sq meters; bag developing fruits
organic_biocontrol.timing: Continuous

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to honeybees. Never spray open blossoms.

chemical.timing: Foliar spray targeting leaf undersides

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Deploy 10 yellow cards per plot
organic_biocontrol.timing: Continuous

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid inhaling spray mist.

chemical.timing: Target base of vines and undersides of lower leaves where adults hide

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Dust powder around root collar or spray 1 ml/L Pyrethrin
organic_biocontrol.timing: Direct contact spray on egg clusters

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to fish. Wear rubber boots, apron, and respirator.

eggplant.name: Eggplant
eggplant.description: Solanaceous vegetable highly susceptible to shoot borers, flea beetles, and mites.

chemical.timing: Spray at first sign of drooping shoots or small boreholes

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Pheromone Traps (Lucinlure) + Clip & Burn Wilted Shoots
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Place 1 lure trap per 150 sq meters; sanitize weekly
organic_biocontrol.timing: Continuous throughout vegetative and fruiting cycle

recommendations.safety_precautions: Prune infested shoots before chemical spraying. Wear protective mask and gloves.

chemical.timing: Spray seedlings and lower foliage thoroughly

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Neem Cake Soil Amendment + Insecticidal Soap
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 200 g Neem cake per plant; 10 ml/L soap spray
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply early morning

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to pollinators. Spray in late evening when bees are not foraging.

chemical.timing: Direct nozzle toward undersides of leaves where webbing occurs

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 2-3 g Sulfur per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Do not apply when temperatures exceed 32°C (90°F)

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear dust mask when measuring wettable powders.
